svg.aria-label: S16 The load queue, entry by entry
svg.text: S16 The load queue, entry by entry
A template whose slots the player fills. Each entry holds its address, the store it depends on and its ordering check.
addr holds the virtual address, then the physical one.
dep names the older store it waits on or forwards from.
check holds the ordering state, from clear to checked to replayed.
Empty rows mean nothing else is in flight.
taken when the load issues, not at dispatch
two load pipes and one that does either
the address arrives a cycle or two later
the store queue is searched once addressed
checked again as the data reaches its register
a line another core writes first poisons the load
a late store match replays the load
an ordering violation flushes, about 25 cycles
the entry goes back before the load retires
the data has reached its register by then
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
